name: smwgraphics-meaty-powerups
title: Meaty Powerups
description:
Tired of SMW original powerups? So you can take a look at this stuff with meaty powerups replacing mushroom, 1-up, fire flower, cape and star.

This pack contains a meat for mushroom and 1-up, a chicken leg for fire flower, a fried egg for star and a fish for cape.

Also changes fireballs to chicken legs.

It uses original sprite palette.

NOTE: You may want to apply the patches in the .zip, which will fix some graphical and sense issues from SMW powerups system when using custom graphics for powerups like this.
